title: Danny B NDE 6018
content: The doctor came in and talked to me. He told me that my heart needed attention, so I was being taken to the emergency room. I do not remember anything of the surgery I had after the knockout shot. The next thing I recall was an attending nurse talking to me in recovery. She gave me a sip of water and said to me, 'Now settle down. You are going to have a heart attack if you don't.' My heart was beating out of my chest, faster and faster, pounding in my chest. At that time, they had called code blue on me, so they told me later. During that time, I could hear people talking and hear my hospital surroundings. I can still remember lying there and thinking, 'What's going on?' I was just lying there helpless. I couldn't even speak. All of a sudden, everything went black, and I mean black. I don't know how long I lay there in darkness, but suddenly, pinholes of light began to appear in the darkness. I heard a low hum, then the blackness was like a wheel, and it started turning clockwise. I was lifted up. Then it stopped, and I was lying there for a while again. Arising in the center of the blackness, a very bright light appeared. I heard the hum again and once again, I was lifted up. I do remember noticing that I could think about things. I was thinking, 'Hmmm, this is nice!' Then it stopped again. Some time went by. The humming started and was moving me up again, somewhat like fog all around me. It stopped again for the last time. I lay there for a while. Then I noticed I was standing up. About three feet in front of me, an image appeared to me, dressed in black. I did not see a face, but I heard the voice say to me, 'Danny Joe!' (That is my given name). 'Danny Joe, you have come a little bit early. You need to go back.' At which time I started descending and then a sudden jolt stopped me again and I rested. It was so peaceful. There was someone standing on my left and I was approached by this figure, but to this day, I cannot tell who it was. I did recognize the voice that had spoken to me though. It was my grandfather on my mother's side. After the jolting and stopping, I remember hearing confusion around me. So many people talking, like I was making a move to another point.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Low hum; blackness like a wheel turning clockwise; lifted up/ascending and later descending; fog all around.

arrival.other_being_detail: An image/figure dressed in black with no face visible spoke to him; another unknown person stood on his left and a figure approached.

environment.environment_other_detail: Darkness/blackness; pinholes of light; fog all around.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Began descending after being told to go back; then a sudden jolt stopped him and he rested.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated cycles of blackness with pinholes of light, humming, lifting up, stopping; later standing and interacting with figures.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No explicit OBE; repeated transitional phases (darkness/light/hum/lifting/stopping) before encountering a figure that told him to return.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Multiple cycles of humming/lifting up/stopping in darkness before the encounter and return message.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Blackness described as a wheel turning clockwise; repeated 'humming' that lifted him up; sudden jolt during descent/return.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Danny Joe, you have come a little bit early. You need to go back." / "Hmmm, this is nice!" / "Now settle down. You are going to have a heart attack if you don't."
